inbound.description: Inbound joins should prioritise NOSU (support number) and REE_NORE (reception line).

outbound.description: Outbound joins should prioritise OPL_NOSU (support number) and OPE_NOOE (order line).

validate_before_update.sql: SELECT REE_ETRE, REE_KEYU, REE_CCLI FROM REE_DAT WHERE ACT_CODE = ACTIVITY_CODE AND REE_NORE = RECEPIT_NUMBER;

update.sql: UPDATE REE_DAT SET REE_ETRE = '100', REE_TOP1 = 0 WHERE ACT_CODE = ACTIVITY_CODE AND REE_NORE = RECEPIT_NUMBER AND REE_KEYU = RECEPTION_KEYU AND REE_CCLI = CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_CODE;

procedures.business_logic: Forces resend of receipt file to Pegasus. BUT REE_TOP1 GETS UPDATED WHEN THE ACT_CODE IS RSAJHJP OR RSADBNPRO

safety_rules: Do not execute UPDATE in production without approval.
